observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: performance space with a white-pillared pavilion and tile floor at night
observation.dancers: four female dancers in traditional costume
observation.formation_and_space: group formations ranging from a line across the stage to moving circles and pairs, shifting positions throughout
observation.posture: upright torso with flexible waist bends, knees often bent in low stances or deep plies
observation.footwork: fast stepping and sliding on the tile floor, staying close to the ground with swift weight shifts on the beat
observation.arms_and_hands: expressive hand gestures with wrists bending, holding large bright orange folding fans or red sash ribbons attached to costumes
observation.hips_and_torso: subtle torso sways, pelvic tilts, and hip drops matching the low-level stances
observation.partnering: solo dancing in unison and canon, with momentary passing contact or facing pairs without weight-bearing holds
observation.levels_jumps_turns: frequent shifts between standing, deep knee bends, and spinning turns across the floor
observation.costume_and_props: matching red and orange outfits with ornate patterned skirts, black tops, elaborate headpieces, and large bright orange folding fans
observation.cannot_infer: exact foot placement details and precise weight distribution due to wide camera angles and quick pans

signature_moments.what: dancers hold open orange folding fans horizontally in front of their faces while swaying slightly
dancers drop into deep knee bends while sweeping fans outward in unison
dancers perform rapid stepping in low squat positions with fans held high
dancers stand in a straight line opening and closing fans rhythmically
dancers circle around each other with extended arms holding fans and red sashes flowing
